subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Elaborar texto teatral, a partir da adaptação de romances, contos, mitos, narrativas de enigma e de aventura, novelas, biografias romanceadas, crônicas, dentre outros, indicando as rubricas para caracterização do cenário, do espaço, do tempo; explicitando a caracterização física e psicológica dos personagens e dos seus modos de ação; reconfigurando a inserção do discurso direto e dos tipos de narrador; explicitando as marcas de variação linguística (dialetos, registros e jargões) e retextualizando o tratamento da temática.

components.description_pt: Compor rubricas de cena que caracterizem cenário, espaço e tempo em texto dramático
components.description_en: Compose stage directions that characterize setting, space, and time in a dramatic text
components.cc_component_description: Include descriptive details to develop characters, setting, and events in a narrative

components.description_pt: Adaptar discurso direto e tipos de narrador de texto-fonte em diálogo dramático
components.description_en: Adapt direct speech and narrator types from a source text into dramatic dialogue
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate the artistic choices an author makes when adapting or departing from source material

components.description_pt: Incorporar caracterização física e psicológica explícita de personagens em roteiro dramático
components.description_en: Incorporate explicit physical and psychological characterization of characters into a dramatic script
components.cc_component_description: Use descriptive details to develop the experiences and personalities of characters

components.description_pt: Marcar variação linguística — dialetos, registros e jargão — em adaptação dramática
components.description_en: Mark linguistic variation — dialects, registers, and jargon — within a dramatic adaptation
components.cc_component_description: Identify examples of dialects or registers used by characters in stories, dramas, or poems

components.description_pt: Retextualizar o tratamento temático de narrativa-fonte em forma dramática
components.description_en: Retextualize the thematic treatment of a source narrative into dramatic form
components.cc_component_description: Analyze what is emphasized in each artistic medium's treatment of a shared subject

cc_matches.description: Use narrative techniques, such as dialogue, pacing, and description, to develop experiences, events, and/or characters.

Analyze the representation of a subject or a key scene in two different artistic mediums, including what is emphasized or absent in each treatment (e.g., Auden's "Musée des Beaux Arts" and Breughel's Landscape with the Fall of Icarus).

Analyze how an author draws on and transforms source material in a specific work (e.g., how Shakespeare treats a theme or topic from Ovid or the Bible or how a later author draws on a play by Shakespeare).
Compare and contrast the varieties of English (e.g., dialects, registers) used in stories, dramas, or poems.
Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.
